episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Taketo Akutagawa is a high schooler who's also a genius erotic writer whose work is serialized in the newspaper. He goes to a school where only people with a unique talent (Geniuses) are allowed, Inspiration Academy! A genius clarinet player, a genus mathmatician, a genius hacker and a genius idol, he gets in all kinds of sexy trouble thisthese crazy people. His fantasies never stop! And what about the love that's starting to grow there? A taboo crazy academic life is about to start!

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: 吹音のために、自分の想いの全てを合唱曲の歌詞に込めると誓った丈途。それぞれの想いを胸に、クラス対抗オリエンテーション大会最終戦、合唱対決本番を迎える。思春期の少年少女達が全てを脱ぎ捨て、溜め込んだ想いを一気に開放して全身全霊で臨む衝撃の大合唱が閃学園に響き渡る!それは熱く、激しく、それでいて儚く切ない青春の調べ。抱えた想いは違えど、伝えたい想いは皆同じ。たった一言｢大好きだ!!｣
